purpose: Privacy-safe measurement taxonomy for agent, crawler, API, MCP, and inquiry-preparation activity.
privacy_rules: Do not log names, emails, phone numbers, message bodies, privileged material, or confidential project facts.
Log event type, path, resource id, tool name, fit classification, user-agent class, and timestamp only.
Treat inquiry preparation as separate from inquiry submission.
Do not infer client identity from crawler or agent activity.
Do not log raw concierge questions. Record fixed question-pattern ids, topic, answer status, fit, route, language class, matched service, and an aggregate pattern fingerprint only.
board_report_questions: Which MCP tools are called most often?
How many inquiry preparations are strong fit, possible fit, information only, or not fit?
Are non-fit requests being routed away before contact?
Which AI/search/referral user agents are reaching the site?
Which representative questions are agents asking, and which approved public-knowledge gaps recur?
